notes: Maker page says the bike is no longer available; it shows $1,699.00 with no crossed-out price (EBR review listed $1199). Maker gives no default/out-of-box speed, only 'Top speed 28 mph' and an adjustable 12-28 mph range ('switch freely between Class 1 and 3'); EBR lists it as Class 3 (changeable to 1/2/3) and EBReport says max speed set to 28 mph, so it likely ships at 28 mph (Class 3), but the maker doesn't say. Maker footnote says the range is for 'A 187-lb rider using PAS 1'; EBR says 176-lb rider. Recheck: maker support center's 'Discover 1 Plus' owner's manual and quick start PDFs are actually the Discover 1 / Nomad 1 (500W, 20 MPH) documents, so not used; the Discover 1 Plus 'adjust speed' article is a video only. Nothing new recorded.
